{"id":"vouch-xlha.7","title":"migrate: verify_continuity re-derives what CheckResult knows","description":"git-vouch-migrate:749-760 and 768-779.
(1) For every person it re-reads people/<h>.json from disk with plain json.loads and re-matches migratedFrom with MIGRATED_RE (git-vouch-migrate:58, a copy of git-vouch:38). But every handle in result.people already went through git-vouch's _person (git-vouch:751-756). That parser raises on a malformed migratedFrom and stores the uppercase fingerprint in Person.migrated_from. So the 'm is None' branch at 755-758 is dead, and the problem-scraping at 760-763 is the only path that reports a malformed one.
(2) It recovers the unchained positions by regex-matching git-vouch's English warning text (772, 'WARNING: changed at (.+?) without a signature'), and malformed migratedFrom by regex-matching result.problems (760). tests/migrate/test_continuity.py:639 and :662 pin the warning today, so a rewording would fail loudly rather than silently. Still, a security gate (stale proofs after a lost-key recovery) rests on a log message's wording.

What goes wrong if it stays: two parsers of the same field can drift; the dead branch reads as a reachable case; message edits in git-vouch break migrate.

Fix: claims = {h: p.migrated_from for h, p in result.people.items() if p.migrated_from}; delete MIGRATED_RE from migrate and the dead branch. Add the unchained positions to CheckResult as data (e.g. unchained: dict[str, list[str]], filled at git-vouch:1724 where the warning is built), and read that instead of the regex at 772.","status":"open","priority":3,"issue_type":"task","owner":"mark@reviewcommit.com","created_at":"2026-10-23T19:23:26.217262931Z","created_by":"agent","updated_at":"2026-10-23T19:23:26.217262931Z","labels":["elegance","review"],"dependencies":[{"issue_id":"vouch-xlha.7","depends_on_id":"vouch-xlha","type":"parent-child","created_at":"2026-10-23T19:23:26.238995921Z","created_by":"agent","metadata":"{}"}]}
